notes.title: Esca: A Short Horror Dive from the Maker of Mucorales
notes.content:
Dive into Esca, a short horror game by the creator of Mucorales. Tasked with repairing a deep-sea station, you'll collect debris, make life-altering choices, and confront the unknown. Prepare for tension and terror as Esca launches December 6th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3344800/Esca/

This time, explore even more with the optional DLC Artbook! Get a behind-the-scenes look at the making of an LuN game, featuring development insights, fun anecdotes, and exclusive behind-the-scenes images. Discover how Esca came to life in stunning detail!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346650/Esca__Artbook/

notes.title: Wishlist Morvyn Gutter now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170450/Morvyn_Gutter/

In Morvyn Gutter, a pixel art horror RPG, you explore a nightmarish sewer system, battling monsters in turn-based combat. Level up, buy gear, and uncover a twisted story filled with eerie secrets and surreal dangers.
